 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Portland Trail Blazers are on the road Thursday night as they travel to take on the Milwaukee Bucks in an interconference matchup.
 Portland enters Thursday's game with a 9-5 record after losing on the road to the Minnesota Timberwolves Tuesday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Portland Trail Blazers guard Damian Lillard (0)Jesse Johnson-Imagn Images
 In Tuesday's loss, Damian Lillard led the way for the Trail Blazers as he recorded 25 points, three rebounds and five assists while Jrue Holiday added 23 points, five rebounds and six assists of his own off the bench.
 The Trail Blazers will try to bounce back Thursday as they face off against a struggling Bucks team on the road.
 Milwaukee enters Thursday's contest with a 1-14 record after losing on the road to the Miami Heat Wednesday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Milwaukee Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma (18)© Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images
 Kyle Kuzma led the way for the Bucks in Wednesday's loss as he ended the game with 26 points and five rebounds while Brayden Burries recorded 20 points and seven rebounds.
 While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Thursday night's matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Trail Blazers Injury Report: Will Deni Avdija, Toumani Camara Play?
 Portland Trail Blazers forward Deni Avdija (8)Troy Wayrynen-Imagn Images
 The Trail Blazers have seven players listed on their injury report, including Deni Avdija and Toumani Camara.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Portland has listed Avdija as questionable due to left foot soreness and he is in danger of missing his second consecutive contest.
 If Avdija is sidelined once again, Jayson Kent, Holiday and Scoot Henderson could all be in line for increased roles.
 The Trail Blazers have also listed Camara as questionable due to abdominal soreness and he is in danger of missing his first game of the season. If Camara is sidelined, Sidy Cissoko could have a larger role.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Portland Trail Blazers forward Toumani Camara (33)Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images
 Ja Morant (left hamstring strain), Vit Krejci (left ankle fracture), Shaedon Sharpe (right meniscus surgery), Robert Williams III (rest) and Chris Youngblood (right foot bone bruise) have all been ruled out.
 Bucks Injury Report: Will Myles Turner, Kyle Kuzma Play?
 Milwaukee Bucks center Myles Turner (3)Daniel Kucin Jr.-Imagn Images
 The Bucks have three players listed on their injury report, including Myles Turner and Kuzma.
 Milwaukee has ruled out Turner due to a left shoulder contusion as he will sit out the second game of their back-to-back.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With Turner sidelined, Kel'el Ware and Jericho Sims could both be in line for increased roles.
 The Bucks have also ruled out Kuzma due to a right shoulder contusion while Ousmane Dieng is out with a fractured left finger.
 Fans can catch Thursday night's matchup between the Trail Blazers and Bucks from the Fiserv Forum at 8 p.m. ET.
